text:
sam: Quick poll 1 1 Fancy a microbrew hop + pocket-games evening this Thu 7pm? Short walk, 3 small breweries, bring a tiny game (pocket-sized only) and we'll rotate. Low-pressure. Who's down? :beer: :game_die:

hana: love the idea. i'm in but can't do late trains 1 maybe 7pm is perfect.

jules: count me in. i'll bring Sushi Go (pocket) and a mini scorepad.

diego: in if there's a veggie snack at the last stop. also happy to steward transit info.

ops-bot: Reminder: team socials under $15/person can be expensed via "team-social" category. Submit receipts and attendee list at https://redwood.internal/expenses.

sam: doing a reaction poll: :beer: = Thu 7pm, :tropical_drink: = Fri 7pm, :x: = can't make it. react please.

hana: :beer:

jules: :beer:

diego: :beer:

luke-remote: :house: i'll be remote but happy to join the last stop via Zoom and cheer.

sam: looks like Thu wins. i'll post a calendar invite with meeting spot (corner of 5th & Elm). planning on 45-60 minutes total. bring cash for beers, venues take cards too.

hana: can we have a quiet corner at the last place? want to avoid loud music for the game round.

jules: i'll talk to the last venue owner; they usually keep one table for low-key groups.

diego: i'll bring a tiny speaker but will keep it off if it's too loud. also bringing napkins.

sam: if People Ops approves a small voucher i'll post how to claim. otherwise pay-as-you-go. ops-bot if stipend ok?

ops-bot: If you request vouchers under $10/person, submit an expense request with estimated headcount. Approval typically 24-48h.

luke-remote: i'll toss some virtual cheers in the thread and vote for joke-of-the-night prize.

sam: perfect. low-key, ~3 stops, pocket games only. i'll pin the meetup and invite. See you Thu 7pm! :sparkles:
